_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Gryt egg in pelican-eggs/voice (MIT).
name: Gryt
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Gryt is a self-hosted voice and text chat server. It needs two more ports: a TCP port for the voice server and a UDP port for audio, set in Startup.
startup: export SERVER_VERSION="$(jq -r .version server/package.json)"; if [ -z "$JWT_SECRET" ]; then [ -s .jwt_secret ] || head -c 48 /dev/urandom | base64 > .jwt_secret; JWT_SECRET="$(cat .jwt_secret)"; export JWT_SECRET; fi; ./gryt_sfu & if [ "{{IMAGE_WORKER_ENABLED}}" = true ]; then node --env-file=config.env image-worker/dist/index.js & fi; exec node --env-file=config.env server/dist/index.js

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Gryt: downloads the self-hosted bundle for the chosen version from GitHub
# and checks its checksum. Your settings (config.env), the data folder
# (messages, uploads) and the session secret are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# Downloads unpack in a folder in the server's (the install's /tmp is
# small), removed when the script ends.
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
rm -rf .raptor-new
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "This server's CPU ($(uname -m)) isn't supported." ;;
esac
put_release() {
    local new=$1 e; shift
    local keep=" $* "
    if [ -f .raptor-files ]; then
        while IFS= read -r e; do
            if [ -n "$e" ] && [ ! -e "$new/$e" ] && [ "${keep#* "$e" }" = "$keep" ]; then rm -rf -- "./$e"; fi
        done < .raptor-files
    fi
    : > .raptor-files.new
    while IFS= read -r e; do
        if [ "${keep#* "$e" }" != "$keep" ] && [ -e "./$e" ]; then
            if [ -d "$new/$e" ]; then cp -rn "$new/$e/." "./$e/" || true; fi
        else
            rm -rf -- "./$e"
            mv "$new/$e" "./$e"
        fi
        echo "$e" >> .raptor-files.new
    done < <(find "$new" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -printf '%f\n')
    mv -f .raptor-files.new .raptor-files
    rm -rf "$new"
}

[ "$arch" = amd64 ] || fail "Gryt is only built for x86-64 CPUs, and this server is $arch."
want="${GRYT_VERSION:-latest}"
tag=latest
if [ "$want" != latest ]; then tag="v${want#v}"; fi
tag=$(gh-release tag Gryt-chat/server "$tag") || fail "Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 1.12.0, then reinstall."
version="${tag#v}"
name="gryt-server-linux-x64-v$version.zip"

if [ -f server/package.json ] && [ "$(jq -r .version server/package.json)" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "Gryt $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Gryt $version"
    gh-release download Gryt-chat/server "$tag" "$name" $work/gryt.zip
    unzip -q $work/gryt.zip -d $work/gryt
    mv $work/gryt/gryt-server-linux-x64 .raptor-new
    rm -rf $work/gryt $work/gryt.zip .raptor-new/*.bat .raptor-new/*.sh
    chmod +x .raptor-new/gryt_sfu
    put_release .raptor-new config.env
fi
mkdir -p data
echo "Installed Gryt $version."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name people see for this server.

variables.name: Description
variables.description: A short description of the server.

variables.name: Voice port
variables.description: The TCP port of the voice server. Add it to the server's ports as well.

variables.name: Audio port
variables.description: The one UDP port all audio flows over. Add it to the server's ports as well.

variables.name: Voice address
variables.description: Where clients reach the voice server: this server's public IP or domain and the voice port, such as 203.0.113.10:5005.

variables.name: Public IP
variables.description: The public IP addresses clients send audio to, separated by commas. Leave it empty to find it with STUN.

variables.name: Server address
variables.description: The web address clients use to reach this server: http or https, then its public IP or domain and port.

variables.name: Identities
variables.description: Who may join, separated by commas: account (a Gryt account) and local (no account).

variables.name: Allowed web origins
variables.description: The web addresses of the apps allowed to connect, separated by commas. Keep the defaults for Gryt's desktop and web apps.

variables.name: STUN servers
variables.description: STUN servers used to find the public address, separated by commas.

variables.name: Max voice peers
variables.description: How many people may be connected to voice at once.

variables.name: Image worker
variables.description: Run the image worker, which makes thumbnails and recompresses uploads.

variables.name: Turn off STUN
variables.description: Stop the voice server from finding its public address with STUN.

variables.name: Session secret
variables.description: The secret sessions are signed with. Leave it empty to have one made and kept in .jwt_secret.

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Gryt version to install, such as 1.12.0, or latest. Reinstall to change it.
